entrelumen.nature.too_far: That site is %s blocks from the Ark. Mark one within %s blocks.

entrelumen.nature.already_marked: Your team's restoration site is already at %s, %s, %s (radius %s). Nothing changed.
entrelumen.nature.no_site: Your team has no restoration site yet. Use this module with a bookmarked compass to mark one.
entrelumen.nature.unloaded: Part of the restoration site is not loaded. Move closer: the Ark never loads chunks for this. Nothing was used.
entrelumen.nature.restored: Restored %s ground blocks, %s native trees and %s plants for %s bone meal and %s saplings.
entrelumen.nature.deferred: %s more changes are waiting. Use the module again with more bone meal or saplings to continue.
entrelumen.nature.waiting: Nothing was restored: %s changes still need more bone meal or saplings. Nothing was used.
entrelumen.nature.nothing: Nothing left to restore within %s blocks of %s, %s, %s. Nothing was used.
entrelumen.nature.saplings: Native trees need saplings in your offhand: one sapling and %s bone meal per tree.
entrelumen.nature.guarded: %s spots were left untouched to protect builds, containers, decorations or claimed land.
entrelumen.nature.journal.instructions: Use this module with a bookmarked compass to mark a site. Then use it with bone meal to restore bare ground within %s blocks: exposed dirt regains its cover, bare grass gets its biome's plants and, with saplings in your offhand, native trees return (one sapling and %s bone meal each). Builds, containers and claims are left alone.
entrelumen.altar.renewal.tooltip: Rebuilds the land the world generator made in a 49×49 square around it (65×65 near your team's Ark restoration site): dug holes, bare dirt, the original trees and plants.
entrelumen.altar.renewal.tooltip_use: Bone meal or another fertilizer, by hand or hopper: its fuel. Each one pays 10 seconds of work and 4 restored blocks (a whole tree costs up to 16). Empty hand: status and area. Crouch with an empty hand: pause, resume or start again. Builds, containers, crops and claims are left alone.
entrelumen.altar.renewal.fed: Fed %s fertilizer (%s stored). The altar restores the original land in the %s-block square around it.
entrelumen.altar.renewal.full: The altar holds one stack of a single fertilizer (%s stored). Nothing was used.
entrelumen.altar.renewal.no_fertilizer: Feed the altar bone meal or another fertilizer first.
entrelumen.altar.renewal.started: The altar starts a new pass over its %s-block square.
entrelumen.altar.renewal.paused: The altar is paused. Crouch and use it with an empty hand to resume.
entrelumen.altar.renewal.status: Altar of Renewal: %s, %s-block square, %s%% done. It works outwards in rings: ground first, then trees, then plants.
entrelumen.altar.renewal.progress: Refilled %s blocks, re-covered %s, regrew %s trees and %s plants; %s spots left alone; %s chunks skipped as unrecognized.
entrelumen.altar.renewal.fuel: Fertilizer stored: %s. Charge: %s. Active time paid: %s s. Fertilizer used in this pass: %s.
entrelumen.altar.renewal.generating: Reading the original land from the world generator...
entrelumen.altar.renewal.failed: The original land could not be regenerated here (%s). Nothing was changed.
entrelumen.altar.renewal.done: The Altar of Renewal at %s, %s, %s finished: %s blocks refilled, %s re-covered, %s trees and %s plants restored for %s fertilizer.
entrelumen.altar.terraform.tooltip: Flattens a square centred on itself at the level it stands on, and blends every side into the land with the same smooth slope. Cut blocks go to its buffer or an adjacent container; filling uses only blocks from them.
entrelumen.altar.terraform.tooltip_use: Coal, charcoal or redstone: its fuel, one minute of work each. Empty hand: preview the area, then use again to start; while working, pause or resume. Crouch with an empty hand: change the size during the preview, otherwise open the buffer. Block in hand: add it to the buffer.
entrelumen.altar.terraform.preview: Preview: a flat %s×%s square at height %s with a %s-block slope around it. Use again within %s seconds to start; crouch and use to change the size.
entrelumen.altar.terraform.paused: The altar is paused after its last whole column. Use it again to resume.
entrelumen.altar.terraform.supplied: Added %s blocks to the buffer (%s items stored).
entrelumen.altar.terraform.status: Altar of Levelling: %s, %s×%s at height %s, %s of %s columns.
entrelumen.altar.terraform.progress: Cut %s blocks, filled %s, swapped %s; %s columns left alone; %s items in the buffer.
entrelumen.altar.terraform.waiting: Waiting: it needs fuel, fill blocks in the buffer or an adjacent container, room for cut blocks, or loaded chunks.
entrelumen.altar.terraform.done: The Altar of Levelling at %s, %s, %s finished: %s blocks cut, %s filled, %s swapped; %s columns left alone.
entrelumen.altar.terraform.fuel: Fuel stored: %s. Active time paid: %s s. Fuel used in this run: %s.
entrelumen.altar.fuel.fed: Added %s fuel (%s stored). Each keeps the altar working for %s seconds.
entrelumen.altar.fuel.full: The altar holds one stack of a single fuel (%s stored). Nothing was used.
entrelumen.altar.paused: The altar is paused: it burns no fuel and its area is left alone. Crouch and use it with an empty hand to resume.
entrelumen.altar.area.fuel: Fuel stored: %s (about %s left, paid time included). Units used: %s.
entrelumen.altar.peace.tooltip: While it burns candles, no hostile mob spawns naturally in the 129×129×129 cube centred on it. Spawners, spawn eggs, summons, raids, patrols and bosses are not affected.
entrelumen.altar.peace.tooltip_use: Candles, by hand or hopper: its fuel, ten minutes each. Empty hand: status and the area's edge. Crouch with an empty hand: pause or resume.
entrelumen.altar.peace.status: Altar of Peace: %s. No natural hostile spawns in its %s×%s area, %s blocks high.
entrelumen.altar.growth.tooltip: While it burns bone blocks, crops and saplings in the 33×33 field centred on it, four blocks above and below, grow about twenty times as fast. Ripe crops harvested there drop twice as much; seeds and Mystical Agriculture essences do not.
entrelumen.altar.growth.tooltip_use: Bone blocks, by hand or hopper: its fuel, three minutes each. Empty hand: status and the field's edge. Crouch with an empty hand: pause or resume.
entrelumen.altar.growth.status: Altar of Growth: %s. Its %s×%s field, %s blocks high, grows about twenty times as fast.
entrelumen.altar.time.tooltip: While it burns amethyst shards, hostile mobs in the 33×33×33 cube centred on it move and strike at a third of their strength, and their projectiles fly at a third of the speed. Mobs you kill there drop three times their loot and experience. Bosses and players' projectiles are not affected.
entrelumen.altar.time.tooltip_use: Amethyst shards, by hand or hopper: its fuel, two minutes each. Empty hand: status and the area's edge. Crouch with an empty hand: pause or resume.
entrelumen.altar.time.status: Altar of Time: %s. In its %s×%s area, %s blocks high, hostile mobs and their projectiles move at a third of their speed.
entrelumen.altar.repose.tooltip: A four-slot coffer that mends the gear inside very slowly: one durability point per item every five seconds while it has Bottles o' Enchanting. Only damageable, repairable items fit.
entrelumen.altar.repose.tooltip_use: Bottles o' Enchanting, by hand or hopper: one minute of mending each, used only while something is being mended. Use: open the coffer. Crouch with an empty hand: status. Hoppers put in worn items and take out only mended ones.
entrelumen.altar.repose.status: Altar of Repose: mending %s of %s items; the most worn needs about %s more minutes. Bottles o' Enchanting stored: %s (about %s of mending left).
entrelumen.altar.repose.no_fuel: It needs Bottles o' Enchanting to keep mending.
entrelumen.exploration.tooltip: Filled map in your main hand: it absorbs the explored detail of your other maps of the same area. Nothing is consumed.
entrelumen.exploration.chart.compiled: Chart room: %s blank pixels charted from %s of your %s matching maps. Nothing was consumed.
entrelumen.exploration.chart.nothing: Chart room: your %s matching maps add nothing this chart lacks. Nothing was consumed.
entrelumen.exploration.chart.skipped: %s other maps were left out: another dimension or area, a coarser scale, or a different kind of map.
entrelumen.exploration.chart.no_sources: No other map in your inventory covers this chart's area in the same dimension at the same or a finer scale. Nothing changed.
entrelumen.exploration.chart.locked: This chart is locked and can no longer change. Compile into an unlocked copy, then lock it at a cartography table.
entrelumen.exploration.chart.no_data: This map has no chart data on this server. Nothing changed.
entrelumen.exploration.chart.structure: The chart room needs a nearby controller and all six modules in loaded chunks. Nothing changed.
entrelumen.exploration.chart.journal: Chart room: use this module with a filled map in your main hand. Its blank pixels are drawn from your other maps of the same area and dimension, at the same or a finer scale. To gather several maps into one, first zoom a map out at a cartography table. Explored pixels never change, and nothing is consumed.
block.entrelumen.atlas_library.hint: Turns enchanted books into lumen and writes any enchantment up to the level the surrounding Eterna allows.
entrelumen.atlas_library.click_hint: Click: next level. Shift-click: highest you can pay.
entrelumen.apotheosis.tier.haven.desc: Every campaign starts here and stays until it completes Act II.

entrelumen.apotheosis.tier.ascent.desc: The world rises to this tier when your team's campaign completes Act III.
entrelumen.apotheosis.tier.summit.desc: The world rises to this tier when your team's campaign completes Act V.
entrelumen.apotheosis.tier.pinnacle.desc: The world rises to this tier when your team activates the Ark.
entrelumen.apotheosis.tier.set: The story sets your World Tier to %s.
item.entrelumen.augment.use: Use it on a spawner to apply the change.
item.entrelumen.augment.inverse: With quartz in the other hand it undoes the change instead.
item.entrelumen.augment.echoing.effect: Spawned mobs drop extra loot: one more level per use (up to 3).
item.entrelumen.augment.ignore_condition: Ignores the mob's own spawn conditions.
item.entrelumen.augment.initial_health.e: Mobs spawn with 5% less health (down to 20%).
item.entrelumen.augment.redstone_control: The spawner only runs while it receives redstone.
item.entrelumen.augment.youthful.effect: Mobs spawn as babies when they can.
entrelumen.arcane.restored: Forging history restored: %s anvil operations cleared for %s levels and one book each. Enchantments, curses and every other detail are unchanged.
entrelumen.luminosity.engineering.toolti: Heliodor's light, held in the shape of its engines.
entrelumen.luminosity.arcane.tooltip: Heliodor's light, held in the shape of its rites.
entrelumen.luminosity.nature.tooltip: Heliodor's light, held in the shape of its gardens.
entrelumen.luminosity.exploration.toolti: Heliodor's light, held in the shape of its far roads.
entrelumen.luminosity.logistics.tooltip: Heliodor's light, held in the shape of its supply lines.
entrelumen.luminosity.habitation.tooltip: Heliodor's light, held in the shape of its homes.
entrelumen.luminosity.source: Only Solsticio's native villagers trade it.
entrelumen.luminous_ingot.tooltip: Metal bound to the sacred light with care. It forges the luminous gear.
entrelumen.luminous.set_bonus: Full set: flight, night vision and no fall damage. Silent Gear luminous armour counts too.
entrelumen.luminous.sword: Its strikes reveal the target; +25% damage to the undead.
entrelumen.luminous.light_repair: Mends in light of level 12 or more; fastest in sunlight.
entrelumen.luminous.never_breaks: Never breaks: when spent it goes dark until mended.
entrelumen.luminous.dimmed: Dark: bring it back to the light.
trait.entrelumen.radiant.desc: Four radiant or luminous armour pieces grant flight, night vision and no fall damage; lights its surroundings; light mends it
entrelumen.pedestal.received: The compass hums in your hand.
entrelumen.pedestal.claimed: The pedestal already gave you your compass.
entrelumen.ruin.placed: Heliodor start ruin placed; world spawn set to %s %s %s.
entrelumen.ruin.exists: The Heliodor start ruin already exists; its arrival point is %s %s %s.
entrelumen.compass.tooltip.unattuned: Not attuned yet; carry it for a moment.
entrelumen.compass.announce.next: The Heliodor Compass turns toward a new destination: %s.
entrelumen.compass.announce.locked: The Heliodor Compass falls still: the next destination opens with the next act.
entrelumen.compass.announce.complete: The Heliodor Compass has no more destinations for now.
entrelumen.compass.state.1: The destination lies in another dimension.
entrelumen.compass.state.3: No trace near here. Keep advancing the Atlas projects or explore another region.
entrelumen.compass.state.4: The next destination opens with the next act. Complete the Atlas projects.
entrelumen.compass.objective.heliodor_ru: Heliodor left this compass for whoever came next. Wake the Atlas to learn what the ruin remembers.
entrelumen.compass.lore.heliodor_ruin: Tuff cut by machines, not chisels. Copper veins in the floor, dead for years. Whoever lived here left in the middle of a sentence.
entrelumen.compass.objective.village_sur: Villages keep bread, paper and memory. The field survey needs all three.
entrelumen.compass.lore.village_survey: The oldest villagers speak of a flash on the horizon, then silence. None of them went to look.
entrelumen.compass.objective.trial_chamb: Copper and tuff, like the ruin: Heliodor tested its machines underground. The first signal needs what they left behind.
entrelumen.compass.lore.trial_chambers: The spawners still run their trials for no one. Someone built them to judge, and forgot to switch them off.
entrelumen.compass.objective.trail_ruins: Brush the soil from these ruins: the lost workshop was recorded in pieces like these.
entrelumen.compass.lore.trail_ruins: Shards of a mural: people raising a sun of glass above a city. On the next shard, the sun has eyes.
entrelumen.compass.objective.nether_fort: Blaze rods feed the exchange routes. Heliodor traded with the heat before anything else.
entrelumen.compass.objective.twilight_fo: The Atlas lost a page to this forest. Its survey of the horizon cannot close without it.
entrelumen.compass.lore.twilight_forest: Portals of flowers and water. Heliodor's gardeners called this place the rehearsal: a world where the light never quite arrives.
entrelumen.compass.objective.naga_courty: The Naga guards the forest's first seal. Defeat it and the forest opens further.
The Atlas points upward, past the clouds. Something up there answered Heliodor once.
entrelumen.compass.lore.the_aether: Glowstone and water in a frame of pale stone. The Atlas stutters: '…they went up to ask… …came back with…'
entrelumen.compass.objective.bronze_dung: The Slider keeps the first key of the sky. Beyond it, the Atlas sounds louder.
The Lich hoards scepters of stolen light. The Atlas wants them silenced.
Heliodor's gardens kept a treaty with the bees. The pollinators still remember its terms.
entrelumen.compass.lore.bumblezone: Honeycomb walls stamped with a sun. The bees built around a seal they were never allowed to touch.
entrelumen.compass.objective.silver_dung: The Valkyrie Queen holds the road to the golden halls.
entrelumen.compass.objective.gold_dungeo: The Sun Spirit keeps the key the Atlas needs to answer. The voices say its name as if they feared it.
entrelumen.compass.lore.gold_dungeon: The key is warm. For the first time the Atlas speaks clearly: 'It did not destroy us. It stopped us. We are still here, inside the light.'
entrelumen.compass.objective.ocean_monum: The Elder Guardians keep the sponges and prismarine the Ark's seals need.
Its portal is the last road the exploration module needs.
entrelumen.compass.objective.the_end.why: The dragon's breath and the End's silence complete the Ark's charts.
entrelumen.compass.lore.the_end: From the island's edge the Atlas finally shows the way home: not a place, a frequency. Build the Ark and tune it.
entrelumen.light_key.tooltip: Hold use to open a passage into the light. It breaks as you cross.
entrelumen.light_key_broken.tooltip: Hold use to travel between home and Solsticio.
entrelumen.light_key.forged: The Ark forges a Light Key. It opens the way into Solsticio once.
entrelumen.light_key.broke: The key breaks as you cross. What remains carries only you, there and back.
entrelumen.light_key.not_owner: This key answers only to its owner.
entrelumen.light_key.locked: The key stays dark: your team has not activated the Ark.
entrelumen.light_key.inside: You are already inside the light.
entrelumen.solsticio.forming: The light is still gathering around Solsticio. Try again in a moment.
entrelumen.solsticio.plot_claimed: Your team's plot in Solsticio starts at %s %s %s.
entrelumen.solsticio.plots_full: Every plot in Solsticio is taken. An operator can free one.
entrelumen.solsticio.portal_resting: The rift rests after your arrival. Step out and wait a moment.
entrelumen.protection.protected: Heliodor's light keeps this place as it is.
entrelumen.protection.locked: Sealed until your team reaches this part of the story.

Take me to the Badlands, where the earth is layered like copper and rust. There my Luminosity will wake.
entrelumen.solsticio.native.arcane.reque: Take me to a Swamp or a Mangrove Swamp, where the witches brew. There my Luminosity will wake.
entrelumen.solsticio.native.nature.reque: Take me to the Jungle, where nothing ever stops growing. There my Luminosity will wake.
Take me up to the peaks: Jagged, Frozen or Stony. From the top of the world my Luminosity will wake.
entrelumen.solsticio.native.logistics.re: Take me to a Warm or Lukewarm Ocean, where the water is turquoise and the ships once met. Build me a dock; there my Luminosity will wake.
entrelumen.solsticio.native.habitation.r: Take me to the Sunflower Plains, where every house faces the sun. There my Luminosity will wake.
entrelumen.solsticio.innkeeper.0.line: Welcome to the Golden Leaf. The soup has been warm for... how long now? Time is odd here. Sit down.
entrelumen.solsticio.innkeeper.1.line: Rooms are free while the light holds. If you hear singing upstairs, don't knock. She has been rehearsing for the festival for a long, long time.
entrelumen.solsticio.innkeeper.2.line: I write every traveller in my ledger. Yours is the first new name since... well. I'll need a favour one of these days, if you're staying.
entrelumen.solsticio.innkeeper.3.line: The cellar is full, the tables are set and nobody has ordered in ages. Bring me something from outside and I'll cook you a meal you won't forget.
entrelumen.solsticio.townsfolk.0: Is it noon already? It's always noon. I like it, mostly.
entrelumen.solsticio.townsfolk.1: The fountains remember songs. Stand close and listen.
entrelumen.solsticio.townsfolk.2: My grandmother planted that tree. She's in the gardens now, pruning. She has been pruning the same branch for a while.
entrelumen.solsticio.townsfolk.3: They say the Mayor's new windows cost more than the whole east terrace. They say a lot of things.
entrelumen.solsticio.townsfolk.4: If you find a coin in the fountain, leave it. It's a wish, not a wage.
entrelumen.solsticio.townsfolk.5: The natives in the trading hall miss the world outside. Ask them where they'd go.
entrelumen.solsticio.townsfolk.6: Careful on the terraces. The railings were a Council project; nobody knows where the budget went.
entrelumen.solsticio.townsfolk.7: You smell of rain. We have not had rain since... have we ever had rain?
entrelumen.solsticio.lore.founding.title: The Founding of Heliodor
entrelumen.solsticio.lore.founding.1: Heliodor was founded where the sun lingers longest. Its first builders raised copper against the wind and glass against the cold, and they called every roof a garden.
entrelumen.solsticio.lore.founding.2: They measured their days by light, not by coin. A child learned to read a sundial before a ledger, and every street was laid so that noon would find it.
entrelumen.solsticio.lore.founding.3: When the city outgrew its valley, they did not wall it. They planted it outward, terrace by terrace, until the hills themselves seemed to lean toward the sun.
entrelumen.solsticio.lore.sacred_light.1: The priests taught that the sacred light is not a fire to be fed but a guest to be welcomed. It warms whoever keeps the door open.
entrelumen.solsticio.lore.sacred_light.2: The engineers of the Council wrote otherwise. A guest, they argued, can be asked to stay. A light that stays can be measured, and what is measured can be put to work.
entrelumen.solsticio.lore.sacred_light.3: The last page of this copy is torn out. In the margin, in a careful hand: "We were not wrong to want it closer. We were wrong to want it ours."
entrelumen.solsticio.lore.solstice_festi: Once a year the whole city climbed to the rotunda at dawn to wait for the longest noon. Bakers brought honey bread, and children carried mirrors to pass the light from hand to hand.
The festival ended when the shadow of the armillary sphere touched the fountain. Nobody remembers who first said how lovely it would be if that noon never ended.
entrelumen.solsticio.lore.copper_gardens: Copper channels carry water to every terrace. The green they take on is not decay: it is a record of every season the gardens have survived.
First rule of the gardeners: never plant only what feeds you. Plant what feeds the bees, and the bees will see to the rest. — J.
It was an ordinary noon. The market was loud, the fountains ran, someone was arguing about the price of honey.
Then the light came down like a held breath. It did not burn. It simply stopped everything it touched, the way a page stops when you close a book on your finger.
If you are reading this from outside, the book is still open. We are still here, between one word and the next.
